name: Gloom Mantle

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text: You shroud yourself in shadow. When you Cast this Spell and the first time each round you Sustain it, you become Concealed until the end of your next turn, though you can't use this concealment to hide or sneak. You lose this concealment if you're ever in an area of bright light.
